method: All 175 fixture panels were opened individually as native 1280x720 light/dark pairs. Final changed families were reopened after the final export. Automated bounds/contrast checks supplement this semantic inspection.

elements.notes: 3/5 entries: numbered pills align; long descriptions remain within their entry columns in both palettes.
2/4/5 layers: names remain separated from chip groups, with even chip baselines and no label overflow.
All five fixtures: level and both tilt signs have a visible beam, triangular fulcrum and attached hangers. Negative tilt lowers the left pan; one/four-item variants remain connected.
Single and four rows: each target tick is on its own track; 100% target remains within the right edge. Labels, actual fills and goal markers stay separate.
All three model fixtures: side accent, icon seat and stacked rows retain their exact markup. Light/dark text is legible without crossing the accent border.

All six model fixtures plus three added fixtures: quiet, line, on and all tone members are distinct; the preserved model card-4 star and empty data-icon seats do not shift titles. Circular market halves and single target card retain hierarchy.
All four model fixtures: three/twelve-point boundaries, two-series and stacked three-series areas keep each coloured layer visible. Bottom axis labels remain below the plot.
All six model fixtures plus added boundaries: 2/3/6/12 vertical bars and 5/8 horizontal bars have visible values and category labels. Highlighted bar retains its colour and pill-ended outline.
All five model fixtures: 0% is a neutral full ring and 100% is fully filled; 3/4-member rows show every ring and percentage with captions beneath.
All four model fixtures: 12-point line is continuous, including the equal 44 to 44 segment; flat fixture stays horizontal rather than disappearing. Values and equal-step labels do not cover the line.
3/8-point and 5-bubble fixtures: axes, labelled positions and size variation are visible in both modes; highlighted bubble stays inside the plot.

Four fixtures: 12 bars with five series, five bars, four horizontal bars and four 100% bars. Each segment/value and matching nested legend key is rendered; fifth role uses neutral n-4, with no undefined a5.
3/6/10 moves: floating increases/decreases and total from zero are visibly distinct. Consecutive bar connectors and final values remain legible.
One-line command, numbered nine-line and Python examples: monospace text is preserved; numbered gutter and filename separator remain separate in light and dark.
2/3/4 orbits: all rings nest on a common baseline, their titles and amounts remain visible rather than being hidden under the inner orbit.
3/4/6 members: outer loop and directional arrowheads visibly express circulation around the centre; arrows remain outside the node faces.
Three-outcome root and two-level decision tree: root stem, horizontal branch rail and child stems connect to the option centres. Labels stay off the connecting lines.
Single and stacked changes: the element-drawn arrow is visible between before and after figures, with increases/decreases separately coloured.
Horizontal order loop and vertical approval branch: right/down/left/up arrowheads connect node edges. Decision text stays within its clipped decision shape.
3/5/6 stages: widths follow values and stage descriptions/figures stay visible, including the narrow final stage.
Single and four-row meters: bars fill to data values, figures remain next to names, and tracks remain visible after the fill.
All six variants: large closing, centre, on/centre, on, stack/image and standard title maintain size hierarchy and contrast; b emphasis is distinct without disrupting the baseline.
12-week calendar, 2-row and 5-row matrices: week/column headers align to cells; cells keep their intensity differences and values remain readable in both modes.
2/3/4 branches: root stem meets the shared horizontal rail; each branch stem reaches its node, and multiple leaves remain within their branch.
3/4/6 spokes: centre-to-member lines end at node faces; they do not pass through node text. Ring and radial relationships remain visible.
Single and triple seats: frame edge and neutral placeholders retain their rectangular boundaries in both palettes.
3/5/7 stages: mood-line segments meet their points; highlighted stage and pain labels remain separate from the line and within card faces.
Five-key and long six-key fixture: all coloured dots remain paired with their names, including neutral fifth role and long final label.
Check, divided, numbered and plain fixtures: markers align with names; long notes wrap within text columns. No old ul/li anatomy remains.
Six/eight neutral logo seats: member widths and gaps are consistent; placeholders are not replaced with invented marks.
Quadrants and SWOT: axis endpoints occupy opposite ends; SWOT marker discs leave room for names and two bullet lines rather than covering text.
Tone grid and named 3x3 grid: all nine cells and active cell remain distinct; low/mid/high axis labels are separated and aligned.
Single, three and four figures: quantities retain the strongest hierarchy, units remain on the figure baseline, and dotted column dividers do not touch names.
2/4/6 branches: curved connectors visibly join branch edges and centre; six-member fixture reserves space for every branch title and leaf.
3/6 nodes: actual node-to-node lines and highlighted connections are visible beneath node pills, without crossing their text.
Single profile and 3/4-member groups: seats, names, roles and nested list are grouped together. Portrait and avatar variants preserve their different silhouettes.
Single and stacked line/on/quiet variations: number/name/note stay centred as a combined group; separators and borders remain visible in dark mode.
2/6 marks and four logo marks: axis extremes, midpoint guides and data positions remain visible; large own-brand mark has room for its label.
Both three-plan fixtures: every plan shows name, amount/negotiation and its nested list; recommendation tag remains intrinsic width instead of collapsing or stretching.
All five fixtures: regular/lead/quiet and paired/column text retain paragraph grouping; emphasis remains readable and long Korean lines wrap within columns.
3/4/5 levels: face slopes line up into one silhouette; text is outside the clipping operation so the long top note in the four-level fixture is fully readable.
Two quotations, large statement and single portrait quotation: quote marks, statement, attribution and role remain separate; strong emphasis has adequate contrast.

3/5/8 dimensions: radial spokes and rings remain under all filled polygons; every dimension is outside the plot. Native light/dark panels show all 1/2/3 series names in exact key.tone-N legends matching the orange/blue/green polygons; keys are no longer all a1.
Two/ four lanes: period headers align with lane grid; task bars span correct columns and the milestone is visible without covering its label.
3/6 branches and nested distribution: source band connections reach branch faces; branch/child proportions remain different and nested labels are readable.
Dumbbell six rows retains horizontal value spans; ordinary two/five pairs join fixed before and after columns by actual sloping lines on the value scale. Endpoint labels remain readable.
24-point line, eight downward bars and nested stat: line segments are connected, bars use negative colour, and nested spark has a nonzero visible height beside its figure.
3/4/6 horizontal and four vertical stages: connector lines reach adjacent faces; numbered marks and empty data-icon seats retain centre alignment.
Two/three owner lanes: owner labels stay outside node columns; cross-lane arrows connect the node edges with directional heads.
3x3,5x4,7x6 variants: headers, selected column, numeric alignment and horizontal rules remain legible in both modes.
Inline highlight and full tag, plus long multi-tag fixture: intrinsic widths preserve surrounding prose flow; text is visually centred in filled and outlined tags.
Five horizontal, six alternating and four vertical stops: date pills are separated from the rail; dots lie on the shared axis and alternate cards attach through stems.
One/ four/five branches: branch widths and tile heights follow values; narrow tiles retain names and figures, with long labels wrapping in their own area.
Two/three sets: translucent fills retain visible intersections, set names stay within their circles, and optional centre caption remains readable.
Both pairs: headings and nested lists remain on their own faces; central VS is separate, highlighted side keeps its border and readable text.
Three-member group, 100 units, 20 toned units and figure units: filled/empty counts match captions; person silhouettes remain separate and visible in both modes.
